answers.how: The rear horse moves about 47.5 px/s, giving a scale of 0.874/47.5 = 0.0184 m/px. Its length is about 110 px.
Around 1 s, the front horse moves about 86 px/s. Multiplying by 0.0184 m/px gives its speed.
The front horse is approximately 135 px long; 135 × 0.0184 converts this to meters.
The rabbit is approximately 25 px long; 25 × 0.0184 converts this to meters.
Around 1 s, the rabbit moves approximately 81.5 px/s. Multiplying by 0.0184 m/px gives its speed.
